caption: The drawing features a woman standing in a three-quarters pose, facing slightly to her left. She is wearing a long, loose-fitting dress with long sleeves that reaches down to her ankles. The dress is predominantly green with a complex pattern consisting of yellow floral and vine-like motifs, accented with blue and white details. Beneath the dress, she wears wide, light-colored pants that gather at her ankles. Her footwear consists of simple, brown pointed shoes. The woman has fair skin, and her brown hair is parted in the center and styled into a bun at the back of her head. The drawing is rendered on a plain, off-white background with no other objects or designs present.
